text:
rachel: Quick summary from todays vela11b int8 runs. Latency and cost look great but we saw a small fidelity hit on short factual QA. Wanted to surface a different unit-econ framing for product: cost-per-acceptable-answer (CPA).
darren: numbers please + CPA idea explained?
rachel: p50 gen 105ms -> 82ms, cost/1M tokens $118 -> $86, short-qa exact match 74.3% -> 70.1% (n=3k). If you combine cost + quality: fp16 CPA ~= $0.0018 per acceptable answer, int8 CPA ~= $0.0012, but note relative increase in unacceptable/hallucinated answers.
sylvie: CPA sounds useful. How are we defining "acceptable"? human label or threshold?
rachel: For this slice we used human labels (binary acceptable) on 500 sampled responses. CPA = (daily cost) / (# acceptable answers per day). Gives product a dollar-per-good-response view.
marco: Interesting. That helps prioritize endpoints by ROI. Any mitigation ideas for short-qa fidelity?
rachel: Two quick mitigations: 1) soft-fallback policy for low-confidence short answers (compute cheap entailment score, route low-confidence to fp16), 2) apply a short-answer post-verifier (small LLM or rule-based) to catch hallucinations. Verifier adds ~6-10ms.
darren: Can you share gate math for verification vs routing?
rachel: Sure: assume 200k daily queries, avg 120 tokens. fp16 cost/day $4,760, int8 $3,470. If we route 12% low-confidence -> fp16 blended cost/day ~$4,120. If verifier catches 60% of hallucinations and costs $0.002 per query, blended cost/day ~$3,900. CPA numbers shift accordingly; I put the quick calc in the drive link.
sylvie: Can we canary this with a paired A/B that measures CPA directly? I like tracking CPA + hallucination_rate.
marco: Ops: set canary flag vela11b.cpa_canary = {int8: 5%, fp16: 95%}. Observability: CPA, EM, hallucination_rate, p95 latency. Rollback if CPA worsens >10% or hallucination_rate +2pp.
rachel: Eval command I used: ```bash
ri eval compare --a vela11b-fp16 --b vela11b-int8 --suite short-qa-factoid --samples 3000 --out /tmp/vela11b_cpa.json
```
darren: Please upload artifacts and the CPA calc sheet. Ill run bootstrap and ROI sims.
audit-bot: Canary scheduled: vela11b-cpa-canary will be created by marco on 2026-03-30T08:00:00Z.
sylvie: GTN note: add CPA column to the model scorecard and include recommended default for short-qa endpoints: int8 + verifier OR 12% fp16 fallback.
rachel: Owners: rachel -> verifier perf test (500 samples) + upload calc; marco -> create canary + alerts; darren -> bootstrap + ROI sims; sylvie -> GTN blurb. Timeline: verifier test by EOD tomorrow, canary early next week. :thumbsup:
